title: ICW Tren Penindakan Tindak Pidana Korupsi 2024 (released Sept 2025)

cases.name: Tin trade corruption (Timah case)
cases.description: Regulatory capture of the tin trading system in Bangka Belitung; the BPKP state audit attributed Rp 271 trillion in losses — the single largest driver of 2024's record total, up 885% from 2023.
cases.institution: Ministry of Trade / Bangka Belitung administration
cases.sentence: 6.5 years (first instance, widely criticized as too light); increased to life imprisonment on appeal
